description: Object B minimum (P2-3): source revisions with content hashing and withdrawal status, and immutable knowledge snapshots pinned to a revision set, partitioned by (tenantId, scopeId) per ADR 0012. Snapshot membership is frozen at creation; revision status is read live so a post-snapshot withdrawal is honoured at answer time.
name: @infosec/knowledge

scripts.pretest: npm --prefix ../contracts run build && npm --prefix ../platform run build && tsc -b .
